title: PARI fundamental-unit lattice cut
objective: Implement and independently replay the smallest source-transparent Phase-4 fundamental-unit lattice cut for the two frozen totally real cubic sentinels: extract_full_lattice selection, integer and floating rank-two LLL transforms, cleanarchunit, and regulator consistency, with exact/arch trace observables and dynamic/native differentials.

handoff.summary: Implemented the bounded PARI 2.17.4 totally-real cubic unit-lattice suffix. The same ordinary Python source matches the pinned source trace under CPython and generated JavaScript/GMP/tagged backends for extract_full_lattice's NULL shortcut, integer U1, real-stage U2, composite U, cleanarchunit, and regulator consistency on the h=1 and h=3 sentinels.
risks: The frozen seven-column inputs take extract_full_lattice's NULL shortcut; the separately translated wide selector is not exercised by this lane.
The binary64 cleanarchunit projection uses bounded repeated 2*pi reduction and agrees within 1e-9, but this is not an arbitrary-precision complex-place implementation.
Clean cubic logs retain 0/pi sign phases and cannot feed a sign-free getfu leaf until doubling/sign-phase or characteristic-two handling is certified.

The complete pnpm test:native suite passed on this workspace, but it was invoked directly rather than through parallel:run; the task remains active because no canonical fresh native receipt was fabricated.
pnpm test:changed reaches architecture:check but the base optimizer opportunity manifest is stale; the failure predates and is outside this lane's claims.
next_steps: Integrate cleaned A, U, and regulator evidence with the getfu lane through an explicit sign-phase boundary.
Exercise the existing wide extract_full_lattice selector when a development field reaches 199 or more unit-lattice columns.
Regenerate the merge-owned optimizer opportunity artifacts in the integration lane, then rerun architecture:check there.
